articles.title: Jet may have broken apart before Florida crash, officials say, as family named among victims
articles.description: Adam Robinson, Helen Sharp, and their two children - Emma, four, and Charlie, two - died after the plane nosedived.

articles.title: Indians turn to start-ups to care for ageing parents as young become more mobile
articles.description: Changing family structures in India are driving demand for start-ups offering services for eldercare.
